title: Your First Business: A Teen Guide

sentences.text: Do you want to make your own money?
Maybe you have a great idea.
You can start your own small business.
A business sells products or offers services to people.
Many teens become entrepreneurs.
An entrepreneur is a person.
This person starts a new business.
It can be very exciting and you will learn a lot.
This guide can help you begin.
First, you need a good idea.
Think about what people want or need.
What do you enjoy doing?
What skills do you have?
Maybe you are good at making things or helping others.
Your idea should be something you like.
Next, you must make a simple plan.
What product will you sell?
Or what service will you offer?
Who are your customers?
Your customers are the people who will pay for your product or service.
How will you tell people about your business?
This is called marketing.
Then, think about money.
How much money do you need to start?
Some businesses need very little money.
Other businesses need more.
You can start small.
You should always talk to your parents or an adult.
They can give you good advice.
They can also help you stay safe.
There are many good ideas for teen businesses.
You can offer a dog walking service for your neighbors.
You can wash cars in your street.
Some teens are creative.
They make and sell jewelry, art, or baked goods.
Other teens can help younger students with their homework.
This is called tutoring, and it is a helpful service.
For example, Mark loved computers.
He started a small business last year.
He helps older people learn how to use their computers and phones.
First, he made simple flyers.
He gave them to people in his community.
Now, many people call Mark for help.
He earns his own money.
He is very happy.
He must be patient with his customers.
Starting your own business is interesting.
It can be hard work, but it is also very rewarding.
You will learn many new skills.
You will learn about money, responsibility, and talking to people.
You can make your own money for things you want.
If you have a good idea, you should try.
Maybe you will be a successful teen entrepreneur too!
